preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer)
Attacker must hold some MARSINU tokens to demonstrate the exploit

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() to set both fees to values that sum to 100 (e.g., 50 each). Then perform a token transfer to another address - the transfer amount will be reduced to near zero due to the 100% fee, effectively locking user funds. The owner can also exclude themselves from fees using excludeFromFee() to avoid being affected.
